typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Playfair Display is used for all major headings. Use Manrope for body, labels, buttons, and dashboard tables. Implement tight tracking for headings and wide tracking for tiny uppercase labels.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Configure these in tailwind.config.js under extend.colors. Do not use generic grays. Stick strictly to this warm, earthy, premium color palette.

patterns.stagger_reveal: Use framer-motion variants for container (staggerChildren: 0.1) and items (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow (left-aligned text mostly).
Implement glass-morphism strictly with `bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20`.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn style for marketing pages; use custom HTML/Tailwind.
Use Shadcn primitives for Admin Dashboard but override colors to match the Khurchi.com palette.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Add generous padding to sections (e.g. `py-24` or `py-32`). Do not make layouts cramped.
No generic SaaS templates. This must feel like a premium editorial magazine mixed with a high-end service platform.
